changes.text: Small preactivation SiLU need not learn uniformly slower than ReLU. With symmetric zero-bias frozen features and equal total feature RMS, its odd channel is z/2 but even channel is O(z²), so even-target kernel energy is suppressed as scale². In sealed dim8 Uniform/Laplace interaction tests, label-free even-energy matching improved MSE .953→.0043 and1.136→.0150; linear targets favored plain SiLU. Scope: frozen hidden/linear head; learned hidden, bias/asymmetry, classification and solver gains untested. Full hidden SGD partially escaped: smallscale SiLU test1.252→.925 but larger-scale SiLU .0068 beat ReLU .139; initial fixed-kernel forecast then failed.

In stable fixed-feature MSE training, full-fit and overfit are target/spectrum/noise dependent, not a universal U=lr*steps threshold. Risk splits into signal-bias plus expected noise fitting; small-SiLU can delay both nonlinear signal and noise. In sealed dim6 Uniform/new-target/noise tests, initial-spectrum forecasts matched24riskminimum steps exactly17/24, allwithin2x; MC risk within3SE48/48. Scope: frozen features, known target/data; learned hidden/Adam/CE/solver transfer untested.
changes.boundary: fixed-feature conditional risk, not universal model selection
